visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen layout featuring two women. One woman on the right has several peanuts successfully stuck to her cheek using her skin fat. They are both laughing and talking animatedly. The background is a clean, off-white studio wall with minimalist lighting. The woman on the left wears a white tank top, while the woman on the right is in an off-the-shoulder white dress. (2) A montage follows where the woman in the dress tries to clamp peanuts onto her face. Close-up shots capture her facial expressions shifting from concentration to excitement as she succeeds. Text overlays like colorful captions and emoji appear in bold fonts. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting her skin texture and the peanuts. (3) The scene shifts to a seated position at a white table. Both women are present, and professional product shots of a red SK-II jar and a clear essence bottle are interspersed. They demonstrate applying the cream to their cheeks and hands, focusing on the texture. The background remains a simple indoor studio setting with neutral lighting. (4) Before-and-after comparison photos are displayed on screen. These shots are extreme close-ups of the eye area and nasolabial folds, showing marked differences in skin firmness. Red arrows and white circles are used as graphic overlays to point out specific areas of change against a neutral skin backdrop. (5) The final section returns to the two women talking directly to the camera. They gesture towards the products on the table with smiling expressions. The lighting is soft and flattering. The video ends with a humorous sequence showing a cabinet overflowing with clear essence bottles, accompanied by glowing graphic effects.

(2) The BGM shifts to a more gentle, promotional acoustic style as they transition to discussing skincare. The speech rate remains fast but becomes more narrative and informative.
